notes: Real captured turn against a signed-in Claude session. The captured initialize result pins claude-agent-acp 0.76.0.
_auth/status_update is a Claude-only notification outside the ACP method set. It is recorded as an unsupported item rather than refused, so no harness event is dropped.
The capture tool redacts the account identity carried by _auth/status_update. Only authStatus.kind survives, which is the behavioural signal this fixture depends on.
The three _auth/status_update events are consecutive apart from the running transition because the two available_commands_update frames interleaved between them are absorbed, not surfaced.

The running transition lands on the first session/update of the turn, which is the first usage_update. Without it the turn never leaves Sending and the adapter journal rejects the terminal batch as an invalid transition.

usage_update carries the context window but no token split, so it is absorbed rather than surfaced. The split arrives on the prompt result; combining the two stated facts yields one turn-scoped usage snapshot and infers nothing.
